newsitem.title: GERMANY: Belarus agrees to fact-finding mission - Bonn.
newsitem.headline: Belarus agrees to fact-finding mission - Bonn.

text.p: Belarus will allow an international fact-finding mission amid concern about President Alexander Lukashenko's respect for democratic institutions, the German foreign ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry said Belarus Foreign Minister Vladimir Senko had agreed to the mission at a meeting with his German counterpart Klaus Kinkel in Berlin on Thursday.
The European Union and other international bodies have expressed concern about a disputed referendum last November which greatly increased Lukashenko's powers.

"Kinkel emphasised that the European Union must have the opportunity to construct its own comprehensive picture," the ministry said in a statement. "For this reason, an immediate fact-finding mission was urgently necessary."
It added: "The Belarus foreign minister agreed to the immediate dispatch of such a mission."
The European Union first proposed a fact-finding mission last month but there was no immediate response from Minsk.
